name: Languedoc-Roussillon
keyfacts: In the Banyuls Grand Cru AOC, the wine is required to be aged in wood barrels for two and a half years.
Crémant de Limoux uses the traditional method.

blurb.text: A large wine region on the Mediterranean coast of southern France. It includes Pic Saint-Loup, Faugères, Minervois, Corbières, Fitou and Limoux.
